text: 8 points A hash table T'[0. .. 12] has size 13, and keys are hashed to this table using quadratic probing to resolve collisions. The quadratic probe sequence for key k is given by h(k) + i + i2 mod 13 where h(k) = k mod 13. The following keys are inserted in this order: 5,24,31,45,62,11,12. Show the results of this process and the final table.
